newsitem.title: USA: Farmland catalytic cracker down at Kansas refinery.
newsitem.headline: Farmland catalytic cracker down at Kansas refinery.

text.p: A catalytic cracker at the Farmland Industries Inc Coffeyville, Kansas refinery was taken down for at least 10 days, trader and refiner sources said on Tuesday.
The outage of the refinery's lone catalytic cracker halved the crude run rate at the 68,600 barrel per day refinery, refiner sources said.
Unleaded and diesel differentials firmed in early spot trade Tuesday in the Midwest after Farmland emerged as a buyer seeking gasoline and diesel barrels in Group Three, traders said.
